# Solar Hijri rules, the instances worked out from the calendar's year table
# (rscale/testdata/persian_years.txt), not from this module.

# Esfand 30, leap years only
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=4
DTSTART:20250320
INSTANCES:20250320,20300320,20340320,20380320

# Esfand 30, else the 29th
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;SKIP=BACKWARD;COUNT=5
DTSTART:20250320
INSTANCES:20250320,20260320,20270320,20280319,20290319

# Esfand 30, else Nowruz
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;SKIP=FORWARD;COUNT=5
DTSTART:20250320
INSTANCES:20250320,20260321,20270321,20280320,20290320

# The 31st, else the month's last day
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=31;SKIP=BACKWARD;COUNT=8
DTSTART:20250922
INSTANCES:20250922,20251022,20251121,20251221,20260120,20260219,20260320,20260420

# The last day of every month
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=-1;COUNT=13
DTSTART:20250420
INSTANCES:20250420,20250521,20250621,20250722,20250822,20250922,20251022,20251121,20251221,20260120,20260219,20260320,20260420

# Nowruz
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=10
DTSTART:20210321
INSTANCES:20210321,20220321,20230321,20240320,20250321,20260321,20270321,20280320,20290320,20300321

# The last Friday of Esfand
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=12;BYDAY=-1FR;COUNT=4
DTSTART:20250314
INSTANCES:20250314,20260320,20270319,20280317

# The 31st every fifth month, where the month has one
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL=5;COUNT=6
DTSTART:20250420
INSTANCES:20250420,20250922,20260722,20270521,20280821,20290620

# Nowruz until the reckoning ends
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=20
DTSTART:37910321
INSTANCES:37910321,37920320,37930320,37940320,37950321,37960320,37970320,37980320

# Mehr 1 from its Gregorian date
RRULE:RSCALE=PERSIAN;FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=7;BYMONTHDAY=1;COUNT=3
DTSTART:20250923
INSTANCES:20250923,20260923,20270923
